title: Strong convergence at rank loss does not imply continuity of optimal capacity
statement: For C*=C3 with locked-triad moment |tau|>2^-12,nu=2^86,the supplied actual smooth periodic G_eps=E11 cos x+E22 cos y+eps*ones(2,2)cos(x+y)+eps^2[E11 cos9x+E12 cos81y+E21 cos729x+E22 cos6561y],0<eps<=1/2,converges uniformly/stronglyL4 to rank2G0. Each positive covariance is full rank; all20cubic moments have only the original-triad contribution,so <C*(G_eps)>=eps tau and <Q0>=eps^2+eps^4. The known QC family F+sC*+nu s^2Q0 and weak/completed Hessian duality give beta(S_eps,ell_eps)>=tau^2/[4nu(1+eps^2)]>2^-113,but beta(S0,0)=0 via ordinary E11/E22 rays,weights1/2,zero backgrounds. The optimizing cubic coefficient diverges as1/eps. Retained gluing gives EVERY globally ROC leadingcF and everymean gap>=(c/200)<|G_eps|^4>,uniform positive translation Hessian and vanishing residual correlations. Thus strong convergence,positive gap and small residuals do NOT imply capacity-cost continuity at rank loss. These fields already have ordinary positive-budget allocations; no nonattainment,negative gap or separation is asserted. Completed producer FINAL source continuity: the capacity-boundary scientific JSON payload is identical to the preceding packet; only seconds / runtime metadata changed. This is not a new discontinuity theorem, attainment failure or negative gap. Square/diagonal extensions are separate new families, and1859 QC/general attained capacity remain open.
